practice_fixes.reason: Question already supplies fibre-optic cable. Criteria revised to assess its technical property and contextual explanation, avoiding credit merely for repeating given information.

fields.solution: Fibre supports high data rates, so it can carry the combined traffic between campus buildings without the link becoming a bottleneck. Low attenuation over the required distance and resistance to electromagnetic interference are acceptable alternative properties when linked to a benefit in this context.

marking_points.criterion: States a relevant property: high available bandwidth/data rate, low attenuation over the required distance, or resistance to electromagnetic interference.

Explains how that property supports the campus link, such as accommodating aggregate traffic, maintaining the signal over the distance, or avoiding interference-related disruption. Do not award a separate point for repeating that fibre was selected.
